entries.summary: Follow bounded checked public HTTPS and GitHub Release asset redirects for catalogs, app payloads and supervisor bundles
Reject unsafe redirect destinations and strip ambient authorization and cookies while retaining system TLS trust, budgets and digest/index verification
Assemble verified initial application candidates into a complete catalog with immutable payload mapping and checksums
Existing 1.0.1 deployments require administrator maintenance of the pinned supervisor as well as Web and manager; ordinary self-update does not replace it

recovery_conditions: Inspect active Jobs and protected journals before maintenance. Preserve authentication, configuration, history, diagnostics and the original runtime. Unknown effects stop without replay; use an independent administrator channel for recovery.
